prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the gritty realism of a subway platform. On the far left stands a woman in a yellow raincoat holding a folded map tightly against her chest. Beside her, a silver trash can overflows with crumpled newspapers. A man in a blue suit leans casually against a tiled pillar, his eyes closed in exhaustion. Next to the pillar, a black backpack rests on the grimy floor. In the center foreground, a child in a striped shirt points excitedly at an approaching train headlight visible in the tunnel darkness. The child’s mother, wearing glasses and a beige trench coat, looks down at the boy with a gentle smile while holding his hand. Behind them, a businessman in a gray tie checks his wristwatch impatiently. To his right, a teenager with headphones around their neck taps rhythmically on a smartphone screen. Further back, an elderly woman with a cane sits on a wooden bench, her posture slumped. A brown dog on a leash stands next to the bench, looking up at its owner, a man in a green jacket who holds the leash taut. Above the bench, a flickering fluorescent light fixture buzzes with unseen energy. On the right side of the platform, a street musician in a wide-brimmed hat strums an acoustic guitar. At his feet, an open guitar case collects scattered coins. A young couple stands near the edge; the girl in a pink scarf whispers into the ear of the boy in a denim jacket. Behind the musician, a vending machine glows faintly with colorful buttons. A rat scurries near the tracks on the far right, barely visible in the shadows. A discarded coffee cup rolls slightly on the uneven pavement near the tracks. There is no digital signage displaying arrival times. There is no security camera mounted on the walls. There is no advertisement poster visible on the tiles.
